D1-hand-front.material_note: Bambu PA6-CF TDS V3.0: dry X-Y tensile modulus 4430 MPa x0.290 humid and strength 102 MPa x0.500 humid (Polymaker PA6-CF20 V1.1 wet / dry), each x0.8 print. For parts printed so their main stress runs in the layers

material_data.name: PA6-CF along the layers (humid)
material_data.note: Bambu PA6-CF TDS V3.0: dry X-Y tensile modulus 4430 MPa x0.290 humid and strength 102 MPa x0.500 humid (Polymaker PA6-CF20 V1.1 wet / dry), each x0.8 print. For parts printed so their main stress runs in the layers

peak.where: sharp inside corner (no fillet: the peak there rises as the mesh is refined)
peak.note: the design peak sits in a 8.0 mm wall only 1.9 elements thick: a peak in a wall one or two elements thick is not a result. Mesh finer there (refine=[(point, radius, size)], a size under 2.7 mm) and check it with converge(); the peak is at a sharp re-entrant corner, which is singular: its stress rises with every refinement and never converges. Model the fillet the part will have

D1-hand-front.assumptions: linear elastic, small deflection, isotropic: E 1029.2 MPa, a modulus in the layer plane (X-Y), and strength 40.8373 MPa everywhere (Bambu PA6-CF TDS V3.0: dry X-Y tensile modulus 4430 MPa x0.290 humid and strength 102 MPa x0.500 humid (Polymaker PA6-CF20 V1.1 wet / dry), each x0.8 print. For parts printed so their main stress runs in the layers), though a printed part is not isotropic; faces clamped where fixed; no contact, preload or buckling
D1-hand-front.why: 300 N down on the deck at the front (a child leaning on it), the turret plate under the riser (D59)
D1-hand-front.note_by_part: the deck and riser at 5052-H32's 193 MPa, the turret plate at 6061-T6's 276 MPa; the deck within 4 mm of a post pad (a rigid-clamp corner) reported apart, against the abuse target 1.2
